descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S23 「手机宽度和 WebKit 上的 Previous Notes，默认状态」 Previous Notes on phone width and WebKit, default state

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Paste and photograph are physician-triggered only. Nothing is read, extracted or written to the chart until the physician pastes or photographs a prior note and saves it, and no prior note is pulled …（UAT TC-13；TFA-92591 AC 6；TFA-92591 How it works 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given Visual lane profiles pixel7 (Chromium) and iphone15 (WebKit), Pre-Round in its default state

When Open Pre-Round with the Previous Notes panel

Then Paste and Photograph are visible and tappable (tap target ≥ 24 px); the panel is not truncated or covered and has no sideways scroll

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：visual-lane checks covered / overflow / truncated / tap on the panel's elements, default state only. The Paste form and saved-note states on phone are in S28

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（automated）

S23 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-13.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：visual。
